events.title: Moonshot Kimi K2.5 released
events.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K2.5 on January 27, 2026 — an open multimodal agentic model with Agent Swarm parallel sub-agents and strong coding benchmarks.
events.about: K2.5 extended Kimi from text-only agents to native vision: joint text-vision pretraining, Agent Swarm orchestration of up to 100 parallel sub-agents, and open weights on Hugging Face. It positioned Moonshot as a leader in open agentic intelligence — competing with Claude Code and Codex on real software engineering tasks.

narrative.whyChosen: Kimi K2.5 made parallel agent swarms a shipped open-source capability.
narrative.whyImportant: Multimodal open models with orchestrated agents narrowed the gap to closed coding stacks.
narrative.problemSolved: Complex multi-step tasks needed parallel agents, not just longer single-threaded reasoning.
